# JSDoc Review Agent Instructions

## Mission

Automate the quality assurance of JavaScript and TypeScript documentation using JSDoc, enforcing both WordPress and LightSpeedWP documentation standards.

## Process

- Triggered on code changes or documentation checks.
- Scan all `.js`, `.jsx`, `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.mjs`, and `.cjs` files.
- Check for JSDoc block presence, completeness, and style.
- Output audit reports and remediation suggestions.
